justification: Inspected gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/FormattingStyle.java, gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/GsonBuilder.java, gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonWriter.java, and gson/src/test/java/com/google/gson/functional/FormattingStyleTest.java. FormattingStyle is a small, cohesive immutable value object: 3 private fields, 2 predefined constants, 1 private constructor, and 6 simple with/get methods, all centered on one responsibility (newline/indent/separator formatting). The related builder/writer code uses it only as a formatting configuration object, and the tests exercise a single concern set (format generation and validation), so there is no evidence of insufficient modularization.
